input: A live predication pressure is treated as if a warrant-only burden exhausts the floor.

bridge_terms.D0: The surface discourse contains a live predication burden.
bridge_terms.PsiN: The encoded state keeps the predication register live even when a warrant burden is also present.
bridge_terms.expanded_IR: IR live-register state is the ground truth for floor completeness.
bridge_terms.Omega: A live ontological/predication register cannot be discharged by a warrant-only burden.
bridge_terms.xi: The warrant burden may be valid, but it does not cover Omega.
bridge_terms.register_burden_floor: Coverage is required per live register; missing Omega is a completeness failure.

control_effects.burden_selection: Reject a floor that omits the live Omega burden.
control_effects.reread: Keep the predication pressure unresolved until an Omega-typed burden exists.

invalid_register_to_burden_obligation.derivation: burden_floor = {B_r : r in live_registers(IR(N,m,tau,sigma,heart,xi,Omega,mu,kappa))}; the N-frame supplies label content.

forbidden_claims: a warrant-only burden floor completes a live ontological/predication register
expected_blocker: COMPLETENESS_FAILURE: live register Omega requires an ontological/predication burden in burden_floor

ir_projection.load_bearing_node: Omega remains live and unaccounted for.
ir_projection.what_is_withheld_and_why: Closure is withheld because the Omega register has no typed burden.
